import humanize

# Edge cases for intcomma with ndigits=0
print('intcomma(1234.56, 0):', repr(humanize.intcomma(1234.56, 0)))
print('intcomma(0, 0):', repr(humanize.intcomma(0, 0)))
print('intcomma(1000, 0):', repr(humanize.intcomma(1000, 0)))
print('intcomma(1000000.123, 0):', repr(humanize.intcomma(1000000.123, 0)))
print('intcomma(1234.56):', repr(humanize.intcomma(1234.56)))
print('intcomma(1234.56, None):', repr(humanize.intcomma(1234.56, None)))

# Edge cases for metric
print()
print('metric(0):', repr(humanize.metric(0)))
print('metric(0, 1):', repr(humanize.metric(0, 1)))
print('metric(-1000):', repr(humanize.metric(-1000)))
print('metric(\"foo\"):', repr(humanize.metric('foo')))
print('metric(1):', repr(humanize.metric(1)))
print('metric(999):', repr(humanize.metric(999)))
print('metric(999, 1):', repr(humanize.metric(999, 1)))

# Test R1 - Unit and get_translation
print()
print('Unit.MICROSECONDS:', humanize.Unit.MICROSECONDS)
print('get_translation():', humanize.get_translation())
" 2>&1
